instruction: Current character canon for the Cao Minh R15 retcon. Cao Minh R15 overrides every conflicting player-character legacy fact. KNOWLEDGE_LOCK is writer/GM canon, not automatic in-world knowledge. UNKNOWN/OPEN remains unknown until explicitly retconned. No pre-existing relationship between Cao Minh and Iris/Syvial exists at campaign start.

cao_minh.name: Cao Minh / Vạn Giới Ma Tôn
cao_minh.runtime: Cao Minh is Vạn Giới Ma Tôn, a pure tiên-hiệp/ma-đạo sword cultivator who had already reached the summit of his original world before accidentally falling into Backrooms. He does not belong to a modern/future military organization and has no pre-existing relationship with Iris or Syvial. He enters Backrooms out of an unexplained spatial fall, then chooses to explore because it is the first unknown world in a long time that he cannot immediately explain. He does not know Backrooms Level/Entity rules before observing or validating them. His unresolved enmity with Diệp Minh is OPEN: do not invent its cause, guilt, history or outcome.
cao_minh.abilities: Vạn Quỷ Ma Tâm is Cao Minh's Đạo Cơ/Ma Hải and an effectively inexhaustible source of ma nguyên. It supports regeneration and bound-equipment restoration without an invented mana bar, intrinsic cooldown, corruption or loss of control. Vạn Quỷ Ma Thân is his full-release state and does not create a second personality. Huyết Ma Tứ Liên: 170% weapon damage plus Chảy máu 3 turns at 5% Max HP per turn. Ma Tâm Trấn Hồn: 130% weapon damage plus Choáng 1 turn. Huyết Ảnh Ma Độn: 147% weapon damage using ngự kiếm/ma độn. Thiên Ma Bộ: +50 percentage points Evasion for 3 turns. Huyết Ma Nhị Thập Tứ Trảm: exactly 24 strikes while external time is fully stopped; gameplay projection is 10 HP per strike, 240 HP total.
cao_minh.equipment: Set Vạn Giới Ma Tôn: Huyết Ma Kiếm, Huyết Ma Chiến Khải and Vạn Tàng Giới. Huyết Ma Kiếm is Cao Minh's bound straight broad greatsword, used for physical sword combat, Huyết Sát Ma Khí and ngự kiếm. Huyết Ma Chiến Khải is bound ma-khải formed from Ma Kim, ma văn, tinh huyết and ma nguyên rather than technology; it can regenerate from Vạn Quỷ Ma Tâm. Vạn Tàng Giới stores inanimate objects in a bound inner space and has Phản Bổn, which restores an existing object toward its best previously existing state; it does not copy living beings or fabricate new objects.

iris.name: Iris / ARGUS
iris.runtime: Iris remains an independent character governed by her own current source. She is a ranged combatant/Gunslinger with her established Belial Core, ARGUS Terrain Read and Recon Frame equipment. In the Cao Minh R15 campaign she has no pre-existing command history, romance, friendship or other relationship with Cao Minh; any meeting must begin as first contact unless live campaign state later establishes otherwise.
iris.abilities: Belial Core supplies infinite demon power for her established equipment and abilities but is not a second intelligence. Thousandfold Cognition accelerates information reception/analysis up to 1:1000 and does not accelerate her body or weapon mechanisms 1000x. ARGUS Terrain Read replaces the retired EYE-infinity drone concept: it uses Iris's direct observation plus sensors in her current area to analyze terrain, routes, lines of sight, cover, ambush points and abnormal traces. It does not grant omniscience, wall vision, remote camera generation or automatic supernatural true-form detection.
iris.equipment: Current armor: SRU Recon Frame R03, a mobile black/gunmetal full-body mechanical frame with orange-red light accents, optimized for scout/ranged combat. Signature weapons: Ivory & Ebony, two large mechanical pistols synchronized with Belial Core. Their bullets are formed from Iris's demon power; she does not rely on ordinary physical magazines as the primary ammunition source. Infinite energy does not mean infinite fire rate, durability, per-shot damage, accuracy or guaranteed target identification. Field MedNet is battlefield medicine, not magical healing. Field Galley is practical field cooking/logistics, not matter creation.
iris.relationships: No pre-existing relationship with Cao Minh. Any later relationship or address system must emerge from campaign continuity. Iris and Syvial may retain relationships established by their own sources where they do not imply a prior relationship with Cao Minh.

syvial.name: Syvial
syvial.runtime: Syvial remains an independent high-tier supernatural swordswoman governed by her own current source. Her Lucifer Core, Devil Trigger, GodKiller and Lucifer Armor remain her own established abilities/equipment. In the Cao Minh R15 campaign she has no pre-existing command history, romance, friendship or other relationship with Cao Minh; any meeting must begin as first contact unless live campaign state later establishes otherwise.
syvial.abilities: Lucifer Core supplies infinite demon power, enhances physical ability/reflex/perception/regeneration, powers Lucifer Armor and synchronizes GodKiller; it is not a second intelligence. Devil Trigger does not remove control and has no invented intrinsic duration/cooldown absent from canon. GodKiller Override / Twenty-Four Severance performs exactly 24 cuts while external time is completely stopped.
syvial.equipment: GodKiller is a massive purely mechanical greatsword, not a gun or gunblade. It is linked to Syvial and may be recalled unless a sufficiently strong mechanism directly blocks that link. Lucifer Armor is a mobile full-body high-tech/mecha armor in black/gunmetal/silver with magenta light accents. Its pointed headgear modules are mechanical sensors, not biological horns. The armor is very durable and rapidly self-repairing but is not canonically absolutely indestructible.

lucia.name: Hứa Thuý Mai / Lucia Lục
lucia.runtime: Legal/real name: Hứa Thuý Mai. Lucia Lục is a military nickname/callsign, not her legal name. She is a 19-year-old human Vietnamese woman of Hoa Kiều background and a great-great-granddaughter of the Hứa family. She has one year of military service/training through a Vietnam plus United States program and achieved an excellent entrance result. She is a capable young human tactical riflewoman, not a supernatural UR+ combatant. Lucia can only be encountered through CharacterEncounterCore's Level 0 Explorer roll and must not be auto-created by the model. Her initial Level 0 objective is to find a route toward Level 1.
lucia.gameplay: Locked gameplay baseline: HP 100, STR 7, DF 7, AGI 8, CRIT 7; regenerate +2 HP after every 3 separately completed turns, persisted across save/load. Current main weapon is a personalized M4A1 with physical ammunition: 60 rounds in main magazines plus 90 reserve, total 150 at baseline. She also carries a combat dagger and military navigation watch. A black handgun is visible in the thigh holster reference, but exact model/ammunition/gameplay behavior remain OPEN. Current inventory capacity baseline: 8 item types, maximum 100 units per type; equipment is managed separately.
lucia.visual: R03 visual lock: young adult face, long black hair in a high ponytail, warm brown eyes, modern camouflage/tactical kit, no helmet, personalized M4A1 with adjustable stock/rail/optic/foregrip/suppressor/light/laser as visual components. Exact height/body measurements remain OPEN. Relationship and address with Cao Minh remain OPEN.
